stories.title: Why AI builders hand back a lookalike of your design system
stories.blurb: Christine Vallaure shows that builders which "connect your design system" mostly rebuild it, usually on shadcn and Tailwind, instead of using the real components, and gives two prompts to check what a tool actually did. The routes that work are built by developers: a Storybook MCP as the quick option, or a custom MCP that also carries the team's agreed patterns and rules.

sources.name: UX Collective
sources.headline: AI Prototyping inside your design system. A hands-on guide for design & product teams.
sources.author: Christine Vallaure

stories.title: Bad Appel sells calvados as a cocktail ingredient, not a digestif
stories.blurb: Butterfly Cannon delivered strategy, naming, packaging and a custom bottle for a category only 35% of UK adults have heard of. The design runs on one collision: classical illustration under hand-drawn red type, with a snake cast into the glass at the bottle neck.

sources.name: Design Week
sources.headline: Butterfly Cannon reimagines calvados with disruptive Bad Appel brand identity

stories.title: Klaviyo borrows its creative standard from its own customers
stories.blurb: Rival software firms describe themselves in the same few adjectives, so CMO Jamie Domenici copied how the consumer brands on her customer list advertise. Where others named their AI agent a sidekick, the campaign by Gus casts Klaviyo as a marketer's work best friend. She tracks organic traffic against spend and admits brand payback is hard to pin down.

sources.name: State of Brand
sources.headline: Klaviyo Takes Its Creative Standard From The Consumer Brands On Its Customer List | State of Brand

stories.title: 64% of young Americans say brand posts blend together
stories.blurb: Born Social surveyed 2,019 US adults aged 18 to 34. Half of recent social discoveries came through a creator, 34% through brand content, and 44% prefer partnerships in the creator's own style against 11% in the brand's. The agency's reading: brands confuse control with consistency. It is agency research delivered by press release, so weigh it as such.

sources.name: Roastbrief
sources.headline: 64% of young Americans say brand social posts are starting to blend together, while creators outpace brands in social discovery, new research finds

stories.title: How the symbol system of Bon Iver's 22, A Million was built
stories.blurb: Ten years on, Eric Timothy Carlson describes the making: 100 sketched symbols that had to read like real ones, printed and assembled into three 33 by 33 inch collages. The lyric videos, made with Aaron Anderson almost entirely from phone footage, screen captures and After Effects, carried the album's digital half.

sources.name: It's Nice That
sources.headline: Decoding 22, A Million: Eric Timothy Carlson on carving Bon Iver’s iconic visual universe ten years later

stories.title: Half of creatives using AI have not told the client
stories.blurb: Envato surveyed 1,033 creative professionals: 58% use AI daily, and 53% of AI users have used it on key client work without disclosure. Taste and judgment rank first as drivers of quality (53%), prompt skill last (19%). 49% say AI makes them faster, 7% say it raised their earnings. A vendor survey, delivered by press release.

sources.name: Roastbrief
sources.headline: “Beyond The Hype: The State Of Ai In Creative Work”. Envato’s Second Annual Report Finds Ai Adoption Has Outrun The Rules

stories.title: Brands can now claim and correct their profile in ChatGPT
stories.blurb: OpenAI's Businesses in ChatGPT beta lets companies verify a profile, edit their details, upload product feeds and see mentions, profile views and clicks. The prompts behind those mentions stay hidden. Eligible US businesses can also sponsor their Business Agent as an ad destination, so the ad product arrived on launch day.

sources.name: State of Brand
sources.headline: ChatGPT Just Became the New Google Business Profile, and CMOs Finally Get the Numbers | State of Brand

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.headline: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’

stories.title: ArtStation hides declared AI work by default and leans on user reports
stories.blurb: Uploads now need a declaration (primarily generative, mixed or none), and a new report channel feeds a filter with strict, balanced and loose settings. Creative Bloq's open points: detection depends on users judging correctly, and it is unclear whether artists are told when their work is flagged or can contest it.

sources.name: Creative Bloq
sources.headline: Is ArtStation's new AI art policy good enough?

stories.title: Adobe opens Creative Cloud to outside AI agents
stories.blurb: At MAX, Adobe previewed native MCP support for Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere and After Effects. Third-party agents work on native project files while layers, vectors and sequences stay editable; the private beta is due in early 2027. Also new in Photoshop beta: Convert to Text Layers rebuilds type in a flat JPEG as live text matched against Adobe Fonts.

sources.name: Creative Boom
sources.headline: Bring your own agent: Adobe opens Creative Cloud to outside AI

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: Adobe is going all in on agentic AI

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.headline: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly

stories.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is out, priced well below its rivals
stories.blurb: Google opens Carbon to paying developers, enterprises and AI Ultra subscribers and positions it above Argon for long, multi-step work. Introductory pricing is $2 per million input and $10 per million output tokens, doubling at the end of November. A swarm preview in Antigravity turns one prompt into a coordinated team of agents.

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature

stories.title: Claude gets Meetings, Sheets and Whiteboards
stories.blurb: All three launch in beta, and Claude Data is now generally available on paid plans. Interactive connectors embed partner apps inside Claude, for example Adobe's PDF editor or a HubSpot campaign tracker. The Verge reads it as a push toward non-technical knowledge workers ahead of the IPO.

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks

stories.title: Mollick on Fable 5.2: expert work, but no sense of when it is too much
stories.blurb: Ethan Mollick ran the model as filmmaker, hardware hacker, researcher and world builder and calls the result almost AGI. The gap he found is judgment: it did not notice when its own work was too long, repetitive or joyless, and its built-in critics only caught errors. That call stayed with him.
